summary: Concrete operational and technical prerequisites required for real validator frontend execution, distinguishing between native RimWorld child worker and standalone validator CLI.

frontend_modes.description: Child process is a secondary, isolated RimWorld game instance running WorkerBridgeMod in READ_ONLY role.

required_cli_arguments.purpose: Headless Unity execution without GUI loop
Native RimWorld engine isolation: sets GenFilePaths.SaveDataFolderPath to ValidatorUserDataDirectory so child config, keybindings, mods config, and logs never collide with simulator worker.
Port multiplexing: assigns unique TCP port (e.g., 29101) to prevent AddressAlreadyInUse socket conflict with simulator (port 29100).
required_cli_arguments.origin: Derived or configured operator port allocation

required_cli_arguments.purpose: Required for WorkerBridgeComponent.TryReadOperatorLaunchDescriptorFromCommandLine in child process to locate admitted configuration.
Verifies byte-level integrity of child configuration before admission.
Identifies launch origin for child admission receipt.
Identifies coordination plan for child admission receipt.
Explicitly enforces READ_ONLY role for child instance (Fail-Closed).
Enforces capability boundary for child instance.
Specifies path to issued ValidatorTask JSON for execution.
Transfers operator capability nonce for authorization check.
required_cli_arguments.origin: Generated in StageSave / issued in ValidatorTask

prerequisites: RimWorld executable must exist and match AdmittedValidatorExecutableSha256.
Child READ_ONLY configuration JSON must be materialized on disk and admitted.
ValidatorUserDataDirectory must be created and writable prior to launch.
Steam/Workshop file access must be shared read-only without concurrent lock conflicts.
Process identity check (VerifyProcessIdentity) must verify PID, StartTimeUtc, and READ_ONLY role.

frontend_modes.description: Child process is a dedicated validator tool that parses staged saves and writes protected results without launching full Unity/RimWorld game engine.

required_cli_arguments.purpose: Specifies task JSON containing all 16 bound dimensions and staged file path.
Optional override for destination result file path.

prerequisites: Binary must exist, be executable, and match AdmittedValidatorExecutableSha256.
Task file and staged save file must exist and be readable.
Result channel directory must be writable.
Child process must output valid ValidatorResult JSON with correct secret tokens and PID matching launched process.

current_gap_assessment.mode_a_gap_reason: HandleLaunchOperatorValidator currently constructs arguments: baseArgs + --task-file + --nonce. It does not emit -savedatafolder, -bridgeport, or the 7 mandatory -operator* arguments required for child RimWorld / WorkerBridgeComponent to boot into READ_ONLY mode.
current_gap_assessment.mode_b_readiness: Current argument format matches Mode B convention, but requires dedicated validator CLI binary adhering to the --task-file and --nonce protocol.
